profiles.title: Amaphrofayela
profiles.what: Iphrofayela ngayinye igcina imisebenzi yayo, inkumbulo, izilungiselelo nokhiye kule divayisi. Akukho okweqa kusuka kwenye kuya kwenye.
profiles.name: Igama lephrofayela entsha
profiles.childText: Ngaphansi kweminyaka eyi-13, iphrofayela ivuleka kuphela ngephasiwedi yakho noma ngokhiye wokungena. Konke lokhu kungashintshwa kamuva, ekhasini layo ku-Amaphrofayela.
profiles.lockFirst: Qala ngokukhiya iphrofayela yakho, ukuze ingane ingayivuli.
profiles.asParent: Ukuze uyengeze, vula ngephasiwedi yakho noma ngokhiye wokungena.
profiles.removeConfirm: Khipha iphrofayela “{name}”? Konke okugcinwe kuyo kuyasuswa kule divayisi.
profiles.removeLocked: Khipha iphrofayela ekhiyiwe “{name}”? Konke okugcinwe kuyo kuyasuswa kule divayisi unomphela: ayikho iphasiwedi, ukhiye wokungena noma ikhodi yokubuyisa ezokubuyisa.
profiles.kind.secrecy: umuntu omdala ocela izimfihlo, izithombe noma ukuhlangana
profiles.help.harm: Thola isikhathi esizolile sokuba naye, ulalele ngaphandle kokwahlulela noma ukubuza ukuthi ubhaleni. Uma wesabela impilo yakhe, shayela inombolo yeziphuthumayo manje. Udokotela, noma ulayini wosizo wabazali, angakweluleka.
profiles.help.abuse: Lalela, umtshele ukuthi wenze kahle ngokukhuluma, ngaphandle kokuphoqelela imininingwane. Mgcine kude nomuntu omlimazile, bese ucela iseluleko kulayini wokuvikela izingane: uphendula nabazali.
profiles.help.secrecy: Mtshele ukuthi akenzanga lutho olubi. Gcina imilayezo, ungamphenduli lowo muntu omdala, futhi umbike emaphoyiseni nakusayithi noma ku-app.
profiles.help.bullying: Buza ukuthi izinto zihamba kanjani, ulalele. Gcina noma yimiphi imilayezo. Isikole sakhe singathatha isinyathelo, futhi ulayini wosizo wabazali angakweluleka.
profiles.tierText: Umzali ukhethe lokhu kule phrofayela. Kushintsha kuphela ngephasiwedi yomzali noma ngokhiye wokungena.
profiles.change: Shintsha, ngephasiwedi yomzali noma ngokhiye wokungena
profiles.topic.body: Ukudla ngokuzila nendlela umzimba obukeka ngayo
profiles.alsoHere: Ngenkathi lokhu kuvuliwe, ingqondo eku-Izingqondo nemithetho eku-Izimvume nakho kungashintshwa, futhi kuhlala njengoba ukushiya. Okuthi “Qala mahhala” akunikezwa lapha: imigomo yakho ingeyabantu abadala. Izithombe ezenziwe lapha zihlolwa ngokuqinile kakhulu.
profiles.shared: Uma ubhala ngokuthile okukufaka engozini, njengokulimazwa, umuntu omdala ocela izimfihlo, izithombe noma ukuhlangana nawe, noma ukuhlukunyezwa, umzali wakho utshelwa ukuthi kuvele ukukhathazeka nokuthi nini, hhayi amagama akho. Uma ingozi isekhaya, abatshelwa.
profiles.hears: Amaphrofayela ezingane zakho atshela le phrofayela isikhathi sazo usuku ngalunye nanoma yikuphi ukukhathazeka, hhayi amagama azo.
profiles.needed: Iphrofayela yengane ivuleka kuphela ngephasiwedi yale phrofayela noma ngokhiye wokungena kuze kube ineminyaka eyi-13. Khipha kuqala: {names}, uma kungenjalo ayisoze yavulwa futhi.
profiles.ownLock: Iphrofayela “{name}” manje inelokhi yayo: shintsha lezi zilungiselelo lapho, nindawonye.
profiles.there: Ophendulayo ngenye yezingqondo zakho, kodwa hhayi i-OpenRouter, imigomo yayo engeyabantu abadala, noma uhlelo lwe-ChatGPT, Claude noma Copilot. Ezinye izingqondo, nezimvume, zishintshwa kuphrofayela “{name}”, ngephasiwedi yakho noma ngokhiye wokungena.
profiles.noBrain: Ayikho ingqondo ephendulayo lapha okwamanje. Umzali uyikhetha kuphrofayela yakhe, ekhasini lale phrofayela ku-Amaphrofayela.
profiles.from13: Kusukela mhla {date}, unyaka wesikole lapho umuntu {name} egcwalisa iminyaka eyi-13, le phrofayela ivuleka ngaphandle kwephasiwedi yomzali noma ukhiye wokungena.
profiles.forAdultText: Yomsebenzi, noma yomunye umuntu kule divayisi. Ingaba nelokhi yayo.
profiles.forChildText: Ukhetha okuchazwayo, futhi ubone isikhathi sakhe nanoma yikuphi ukukhathazeka, hhayi amagama akhe.
profiles.toChange: Ukuze ukushintshe, vula ngephasiwedi yakho noma ngokhiye wokungena.
